resources.string: Downloading speech recognition model (%1$s MB) for faster subtitle sync…
Connect to Wi-Fi once to download the %1$s MB speech model for faster subtitle sync
No look-ahead for %1$s audio on this device, syncing from live audio (slower)
Couldn\'t confirm subtitle sync, restored original timing
Subtitle sync confirmed (%1$s, frame rate corrected)
Shows a live panel in the top-left corner of the player with what audio sync has heard and why it is or isn\'t synced yet.
Couldn\'t sync subtitles to audio yet, still listening
Listens during playback only. No extra data is used, but sync can take longer. The mpv player can only sync to audio with Low or High.
Reads a few short dialogue samples ahead of playback over one connection, up to 75 MB per title. Used on metered networks even when set to High.

Default. Reads more dialogue samples over several connections for the fastest sync, usually up to 150 MB per title and up to 400 MB for very high-bitrate files. Some hosts limit connections per stream.
